map.由扭矩与直径求轴表面剪应力 使用指南: Shaft Surface Shear Stress from Torque and Diameter User Guide
map.输入圆轴扭矩 T 与直径 d，按极惯性矩 J=πd⁴/32 计算轴表面最大剪应力: Enter the torque T and diameter d of a circular shaft and compute the maximum surface shear stress τ = T·r/J from the polar moment of inertia J = πd⁴/32, for shear strength checks and sizing of drive shafts and spindles under torsion.
map.输入扭矩 T 与轴直径 d，求表面最大剪应力。: Enter torque T and shaft diameter d to find the maximum surface shear stress.
map.传动轴在扭矩下外表面最大剪应力。: Maximum shear stress on the outer surface of a drive shaft under torque.
map.轴径选择满足许用剪应力。: Choose a shaft diameter that satisfies the allowable shear stress.
map.与扭转角联合刚度/强度设计。: Combined stiffness and strength design with the angle of twist.
map.：d 0.05→0.10：τ 降至 1/8=2.55 MPa。: Going from d = 0.05 to 0.10 drops τ to one eighth, 2.55 MPa.
map.从轴心零线性增到外表面最大，故大轴径显著降低 τ_max。: It rises linearly from zero at the axis to a maximum at the outer surface, so a larger shaft diameter markedly lowers τ_max.
map.τ_max 须小于材料许用剪应力，且与扭转角共同约束。: τ_max must stay below the allowable shear stress of the material, and the angle of twist constrains the design jointly.
